QuestInfo.name: Chromile's Diary - Part 1
QuestInfo.0: Ugh, this couldn't be easy, now could it?
QuestInfo.1: Pages are missing from the diary! Search the #b#eDark Stumps#n#k on #bDusty Wind Hill#k for the missing Diary Pages.
QuestInfo.2: You found a missing section of the diary and now have the details about the day the Unidentified Assailants kidnapped your mother. You're going to need the other sections for the other details.
QuestInfo.parent: Where in Maple World is Chromile the Knight?

0.0: I'm tired of Winston's games. The Dark Stumps had the cover of that diary, so they must have the rest.

no.0: I'm pretty sure I was right about that.

1.0: The writing is almost illegible, but I think I can read it... \r\n#b'Day 25\nI can't stop thinking it was my fault for letting them get captured. I couldn't do anything when they were taken.  And now I'm supposed to choose. How do you choose between the love of your life or the child you brought into this world? Tomorrow, I have to make that choice, and I don't know what I'm going to do.'
1.1: A choice? Between me and mom? So... he chose me... No, I can't be sure with just this. This isn't the whole picture...
